sources.title: Praxis: ulixacaltamide NDA accepted
sources.summary: Praxis reported FDA acceptance of the oral ulixacaltamide NDA for adult essential tremor, a January 29, 2027 target, and no planned advisory committee. Essential3 provides phase 3 evidence. This application is distinct from relutrigine and from a transdermal ulixacaltamide development program.

sources.title: Ionis: zilganersen priority review accepted
sources.summary: Ionis reported priority review for the zilganersen NDA in pediatric and adult Alexander disease, with September 22, 2026 as the original action target. This historical acceptance predates FDA approval on September 3.

sources.title: FDA: zilganersen approved for Alexander disease
sources.summary: FDA announced approval of Zanvastro (zilganersen) injection for Alexander disease in pediatric and adult patients on September 3, 2026. This is an actual regulatory outcome, superseding an older pending-review calendar entry.

sources.title: FDA: novel drug approvals in 2026
sources.summary: FDA’s list records zilganersen approval on September 3 for Alexander disease and relacorilant approval on March 25 for platinum-resistant ovarian, fallopian-tube or primary peritoneal cancer. Relacorilant’s oncology outcome is not approval of its separate Cushing’s syndrome application. The CDER novel-drug list is not a comprehensive pending or supplemental-application register.

sources.title: Ionis / GSK: bepirovirsen priority review
sources.summary: Ionis reported acceptance and priority review of GSK’s bepirovirsen NDA for chronic hepatitis B, with an October 26, 2026 target. The B-Well trials evaluate functional cure, defined using sustained undetectable surface antigen after treatment cessation; it should not be described as eradication of every viral reservoir.

sources.title: Ionis: second-quarter regulatory update
sources.summary: Ionis continued to report October 26 as bepirovirsen’s FDA target. Its then-pending September 22 zilganersen target was later overtaken by September 3 FDA approval; the July document alone cannot establish September review status.

sources.title: Daiichi Sankyo / Merck: ifinatamab deruxtecan priority BLA
sources.summary: The sponsors reported priority review with an October 10 target for ifinatamab deruxtecan in adults with extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer after progression on or after platinum chemotherapy. The phase 2 IDeate-Lung01 dose-expansion evidence is not a randomized comparison against standard treatment. FDA review programs and acceptance do not establish approval.

sources.title: Roche: adjuvant atezolizumab filing in biomarker-defined colon cancer
sources.summary: Roche reported priority review of supplemental applications for Tecentriq and Tecentriq Hybreza with FOLFOX6 in stage III dMMR/MSI-H colon cancer, targeting October 9. ATOMIC showed a disease-free-survival benefit; that endpoint and molecularly defined population should not be generalized to overall survival or all colorectal cancers.

sources.title: Roche: satralizumab TED filing and discordant pivotal results
sources.summary: Roche reported priority review and an October 15 target for Enspryng in moderate-to-severe thyroid eye disease. SatraGO-2 met its proptosis-response primary endpoint (53% versus 23%). SatraGO-1 showed a numerical difference (49% versus 31%) that was not statistically significant. Existing approval in NMOSD does not establish efficacy or approval in TED.

sources.title: Pharming: pediatric leniolisib resubmission accepted
sources.summary: Pharming reported acceptance of the Joenja sNDA resubmission, targeting October 24 after a January 30 CRL and March 26 Type A meeting. The resubmission addresses analytical-method and batch-testing requests. It covers children aged 4–11 weighing at least 27 kg using 40/50 mg twice daily; lower-weight children require a separate submission.

sources.title: INOVIO: INO-3107 review and eligibility questions
sources.summary: INOVIO reported an October 30 BLA target for INO-3107 in adult recurrent respiratory papillomatosis and completion of scheduled prelicensure inspections. An informal clinical meeting did not discuss accelerated-approval eligibility; the sponsor’s view that the drug qualifies is not FDA concurrence. Confirmatory-trial feedback was still expected.

sources.title: BridgeBio: BBP-418 priority NDA accepted
sources.summary: BridgeBio reported a November 27 target and priority review for oral BBP-418 in LGMD2I/R9. The filing relies on a prespecified 12-month FORTIFY interim analysis that the sponsor says met primary and key secondary endpoints. No advisory committee was planned at the announcement; longer-term follow-up and the final regulatory assessment remain distinct.

sources.title: BridgeBio: BBP-418 and encaleret review update
sources.summary: BridgeBio reported accepted priority-review NDAs for BBP-418 in LGMD2I/R9 with a November 27, 2026 target and encaleret in ADH1 with a May 8, 2027 target, with no planned advisory committee for either. Its infigratinib NDA had been submitted but lacked a reported target; that stage must not be conflated with acceptance.

sources.title: Cogent: bezuclastinib plus sunitinib GIST NDA accepted
sources.summary: Cogent reported priority review and a November 30 target for bezuclastinib plus sunitinib in GIST after imatinib. In PEAK, median PFS was 16.5 versus 9.2 months (HR 0.50; 95% CI 0.39–0.65). This is combination evidence in GIST, separate from bezuclastinib monotherapy in systemic mastocytosis.

sources.title: Cogent: bezuclastinib non-advanced SM NDA accepted
sources.summary: Cogent reported an accepted NDA and December 30 target for bezuclastinib in non-advanced systemic mastocytosis. The sponsor says SUMMIT met its primary and key secondary endpoints. SUMMIT is registered as phase 2 despite its pivotal role; this episode excludes the separate GIST combination and advanced-SM programs.

sources.title: Roche: adjuvant giredestrant priority review
sources.summary: Roche reported priority review with a November 30 target for adjuvant giredestrant in ER-positive/HER2-negative stage I–III breast cancer. lidERA showed invasive disease-free-survival HR 0.70 (95% CI 0.57–0.87), with three-year estimates 92.4% versus 89.6%; overall survival remained immature. Relative hazard reduction is not the absolute benefit.

sources.title: Roche: giredestrant plus everolimus filing
sources.summary: Roche reported a December 18 target for giredestrant plus everolimus in ESR1-mutated, ER-positive/HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after endocrine therapy. evERA results in the ESR1-mutated population differ from the overall population and should not be interchanged. This combination filing is separate from adjuvant giredestrant.

sources.title: Roche: half-year 2026 regulatory portfolio update
sources.summary: Roche’s half-year update lists the 2026 US filings for adjuvant giredestrant, giredestrant plus everolimus, adjuvant atezolizumab and satralizumab in TED. It supports portfolio context; individual acceptance releases supply the exact target dates and trial limitations.

sources.title: Vertex: povetacicept BLA accepted
sources.summary: Vertex reported a November 30 target for the povetacicept BLA seeking accelerated approval in adult IgA nephropathy. The RAINIER interim analysis reported 49.8% placebo-adjusted reduction in urine protein-to-creatinine ratio at week 36. The later 104-week eGFR-slope assessment addresses renal-function benefit and is not an observed result of this interim analysis.

sources.title: Exelixis: zanzalintinib plus atezolizumab NDA accepted
sources.summary: Exelixis reported a December 3 target for zanzalintinib plus atezolizumab in previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer. STELLAR-303 compares the combination with regorafenib and has dual overall-survival endpoints: the intent-to-treat population and patients without liver metastases. The proposed setting follows fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin and irinotecan, plus anti-EGFR therapy when RAS wild type.

sources.title: Exelixis: STELLAR-303 final subgroup result and NDA update
sources.summary: Exelixis reaffirmed the December 3 target. STELLAR-303 had met its ITT overall-survival primary endpoint, but the final analysis announced in June 2026 did not reach significance for the other primary endpoint, OS in patients without liver metastases. A positive overall result cannot be described as both primary populations succeeding. The trial enrolled non-MSI-high disease.

sources.title: Vanda: imsidolimab BLA accepted for GPP
sources.summary: Vanda reported FDA filing acceptance of imsidolimab for generalized pustular psoriasis and a December 12 target. Its GEMINI program includes an acute controlled efficacy study and longer-term maintenance follow-up. Different periods and populations should not be collapsed into a single two-year placebo-controlled effect.

sources.title: Vanda: imsidolimab review update
sources.summary: Vanda continued to report the imsidolimab BLA under FDA review for generalized pustular psoriasis with a December 12, 2026 target. Corporate launch planning or non-US orphan designation does not constitute a US approval.

sources.title: Corcept: relacorilant Cushing’s resubmission target
sources.summary: Corcept reported a resubmitted relacorilant NDA for Cushing’s syndrome and a December 17 target. GRACE is a pivotal randomized-withdrawal study enrolling 152 patients. The Cushing’s application remains separate from relacorilant’s already approved oncology use.

sources.title: Corcept: relacorilant Cushing’s NDA resubmitted
sources.summary: Corcept resubmitted relacorilant for Cushing’s syndrome with FDA-requested additional analyses of data in the original application. The package includes GRACE, GRADIENT and long-term follow-up; sponsor-reported positive trials and resubmission do not establish FDA agreement that prior questions are resolved.

sources.title: Mineralys: lorundrostat NDA accepted; separate OSA trial result
sources.summary: Mineralys reported FDA acceptance of lorundrostat for adult hypertension as an adjunct to other therapies, with a December 22 target, supported by Launch-HTN and Advance-HTN. In the same release, the separate Explore-OSA trial missed its apnea-hypopnea-index primary endpoint despite a blood-pressure signal. Hypertension and sleep-apnea endpoints are different claims.

sources.title: Gilead: anito-cel BLA target and Arcellx transaction
sources.summary: Gilead reported accepted FDA review of anitocabtagene autoleucel for fourth-line relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with a December 23 target. The filing follows iMMagine-1 phase 2 and phase 1 evidence. The announced Arcellx acquisition was still a proposed transaction on this date.

sources.title: Gilead: Arcellx acquisition completed
sources.summary: Gilead completed its acquisition of Arcellx, making it wholly owned. Anito-cel remained under FDA review; corporate ownership and launch readiness are not regulatory clearance. Current sponsor mapping uses Gilead/Kite rather than presenting Arcellx as an independent listed company.

sources.title: Hansa: imlifidase US action date
sources.summary: Hansa reported December 19, 2026 as the target for its accepted imlifidase BLA, intended to enable deceased-donor kidney transplantation in highly sensitized adults with a positive crossmatch. The date is December 19, not December 9. Existing European conditional authorization does not imply a US approval.

sources.title: Agios: mitapivat sickle-cell sNDA priority review
sources.summary: Agios reported priority review of its mitapivat sickle-cell sNDA submitted through the accelerated-approval pathway, with a November 1 target. RISEUP evaluates hemoglobin response and sickle-cell pain crises; REIGNITE is a separate confirmatory transfusion-burden study. Acceptance and planned confirmation must not be represented as demonstrated reduction in clinical events.

sources.title: Mirum: zilurgisertib review and pivotal endpoint risk
sources.summary: Mirum’s second-quarter 2026 Form 10-Q reports an accepted zilurgisertib NDA with a September 26 target and its April licensing agreement with Incyte. It explicitly states the pivotal study did not reach statistical significance on the primary endpoint and the NDA is supported by secondary endpoints. Exact filing day was not established in this snapshot.

sources.title: Mirum / Incyte: zilurgisertib PROGRESS data and NDA
sources.summary: The sponsors reported priority review and a September 26 target for zilurgisertib in FOP in patients aged 12 and older. Their phase 2 PROGRESS release highlights reductions in heterotopic ossification and flare activity, including nominal p-values. These positive secondary analyses require reconciliation with the Form 10-Q disclosure of a nonsignificant primary endpoint.

sources.title: BioXcel: IGALMI at-home sNDA accepted
sources.summary: BioXcel reported acceptance of its supplemental NDA for dexmedetomidine sublingual film for acute agitation associated with bipolar disorder or schizophrenia in the at-home setting, with a November 14 target. This is a proposed setting expansion, separate from the established supervised-use indication; SERENITY III supplies the relevant study context.

sources.title: Mineralys: ongoing lorundrostat NDA review
sources.summary: Mineralys reaffirmed ongoing FDA review of lorundrostat for hypertension with other antihypertensive drugs and the December 22 target. Its commercial preparations are conditional on approval.

sources.title: Cogent: bezuclastinib application status update
sources.summary: Cogent reaffirmed November 30 for its GIST combination NDA and December 30 for its non-advanced systemic mastocytosis NDA. A third NDA for advanced systemic mastocytosis was submitted June 30; this disclosure does not provide acceptance or a target for that separate application.

sources.title: BioXcel: Chapter 11 and proposed Teva asset sale
sources.summary: BioXcel announced voluntary Chapter 11 proceedings and a stalking-horse asset-sale agreement with Teva for assets including IGALMI and the pending at-home sNDA. The transaction is subject to the court-supervised sale process, not a completed transfer. BioXcel explicitly stated it continued supporting the sNDA with November 14 as the target.

sources.title: Agios: RISE UP hemoglobin benefit and missed pain endpoint
sources.summary: Agios reported RISE UP phase 3 hemoglobin response of 40.6% versus 2.9%, p<0.0001. The separate primary endpoint of annualized sickle-cell pain crises did not reach significance, and overall fatigue did not differ. Analyses restricted to hemoglobin responders were post hoc; they do not preserve the original randomized comparison.
